# Shared secret sample fixture for TS + Rust redaction parity tests.
#
# SYNC ANCHOR: This file is consumed by:
#   - cli/src/plugins/repl/redaction.rs  (Rust parity integration tests)
#   - src/plugins/repl/security.test.ts  (SHARED_SECRET_SAMPLES constant mirrors this)
#
# Format: one sample per line. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
# Each sample is a token that MUST be redacted by BOTH the Rust and TS redactors.
#
# When adding a new credential family:
# 1. Add sample here
# 2. Add pattern to cli/src/plugins/repl/redaction.rs REDACTION_PATTERNS
# 3. Add pattern to src/plugins/repl/redaction.ts REDACTION_PATTERNS
# 4. Add name to EXPECTED_PATTERN_NAMES in security.test.ts
# 5. Run cargo test --test repl_observability and vitest run to confirm parity
#
